notes.title: New animated options for main character
notes.content:
Thanks to everybody who report me the bugs in the game and give the ideas about new functions and improvements!
I have made by your requests:

Game play functions:
+ S variants for main character (Now only for female. For male I will create animations a little later)
+ Animation speed slider for s options
+ Hot keys for s options
1...0 - S options changer
+- - animation speed
+ Undress button
